# HashChat (formerly Mingle)

> HashChat is a social network and voice messenger without language barriers: a translated feed, profiles that show the languages people speak and want, and chats with real-time voice interpreting, for making foreign friends, joining global communities, and talking while traveling. It was called Mingle until October 2026; HashChat and Mingle are the same app, with the same accounts and the same App Store and Google Play listings. It is made by Mingle Labs.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759795134
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.minglelabs.mingle.rn
- Company: https://minglelabs.app/
- The old site at translator.minglelabs.xyz has moved to translator.minglelabs.app.

- [The AI Wrapper Business: Surfers Cohort 3 Edition](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs/ai-wrapper-business-surfers-3rd): the first, longer version of the AI wrapper talk (Aug 12, 2026)
- [HashChat Pitch Deck](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs/hashchat-pitch-deck): why HashChat exists, early users, and the path from live interpreter to AI-native social network
- [HashChat Pitch Deck: The Short Version](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs/hashchat-pitch-deck-short): the chicken-and-egg problem of language exchange and how live interpretation removes it
- [Virtually deck](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs/virtually-deck): VTuber live streaming powered by generative AI
- [HashChat: the social network without language barriers](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs/hashchat-social-network): how Mingle grew from a live voice translator into HashChat, a social network with a translated feed, language-aware profiles, and chats with a live interpreter; compared with LINE, WeChat, WhatsApp, HelloTalk, Tandem, Instagram, and Discord
- [AI Translators Comparison](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs/ai-translators-comparison): HashChat compared with Felo Translator, Transync, Google Translate, Apple Translate, Microsoft Translator, Papago, and DeepL for live spoken conversations
- [HashChat Blog](https://translator.minglelabs.app/blogs): all posts
